run_evaluation: run a GAN evaluation method by name using eval.py with model and iteration arguments
run_evaluation_no_vis: run a GAN evaluation with visualization disabled using the --no_vis flag
run_evaluation_np_vis: run a GAN evaluation using the numpy visualizer for SLURM environments
run_evaluation_with_stats: run a GAN evaluation and output results to a statistics file path
run_evaluation_help: get help for a specific evaluation method by running eval.py evaluation_name -h
